## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7af64885822a1b5d399d5f1c5a3a261b4511f536`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #12365 body, the triage grade (`6166805143`), the claim (`6166921786`), the os-dev-report (`6167481283`); PR #12368 body, its 15-file list and net diff; the head's 33 check-runs (`filter=latest`: every one `success` or `skipped`, the skips are the coverage matrix and dependabot); `package.json` and `src/index.ts` of `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n` at head and at base `ccd7e94` (byte-identical at both refs for all three); `createAuthenticatedFetch.ts`, `AuthProvider.tsx` and the i18n `locales/index.ts` and `en.ts` at head; objectstack `origin/main` (`e4ec6ec`) and the objectstack#23440 branch head `5b59be6` for the spec enum.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set of `detectAuthGate`: `MFA_REQUIRED | PASSWORD_EXPIRED` becomes `MFA_REQUIRED | PASSWORD_EXPIRED | PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED`.** Right. The diff replaces the two-literal `||` test with a module-private `AUTH_GATE_CODES` set of exactly those three strings, guarded by `typeof code === 'string'`; the 403-only and `error.code` shape checks are untouched. The objectstack#23440 branch's `AuthGateCodeSchema = z.enum(['PASSWORD_EXPIRED', 'PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED', 'MFA_REQUIRED'])` has the same three members, so the set equals the producer's vocabulary.
- **`detectAuthGate` and `AuthGateInfo` are NOT on the published face.** Verified, the dev's measurement holds. `@object-ui/auth` `exports` is the single `"."` entry (`./dist/index.js` / `./dist/index.d.ts`) at head and base; `src/index.ts` has no `auth-gate-events` export at either ref. `dist/auth-gate-events.d.ts` ships under `files: ["dist"]` but an `exports` map blocks deep specifiers, so no consumer reaches it. The claim's sentence "the published `detectAuthGate`" was wrong on mechanism; the dev corrected it in the PR body and the report. The `yes` it carried still stands, by the next item.
- **The widening that IS published is behavioural: `createAuthenticatedFetch` (exported) now emits the gate for one more 403 code, so `AuthProvider.remediationRequired` (exported through `useAuth`) is set for it.** Right. `createAuthenticatedFetch.ts` calls `detectAuthGate` on every `isApiCall && status === 403` response and emits; `AuthProvider.tsx` subscribes and sets `remediationRequired` (`prev ?? gate`). Its type stays `{ code: string; message: string } | null`, so a consumer's switch over `code` compiles unchanged and sees one more runtime value.
- **`AuthGateInfo.code` literal union gains `'PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED'`.** Correct and type-inert: the union already ends in `| string`, so it collapses to `string` before and after; only documentation changes, and the type is unreachable anyway.
- **`RemediationOverlay` (exported from `@object-ui/app-shell`'s entry, unchanged export line) routes `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` to the change-password form, the same branch `PASSWORD_EXPIRED` takes; the MFA form stays the `else`.** Right. `ExpiredPasswordForm` renamed to `ChangePasswordForm` with a `forcedReset` prop is module-private, not exported, so no public symbol moves.
- **Copy: a forced reset shows `auth.remediation.password.resetTitle` ("You must change your password"); `PASSWORD_EXPIRED` keeps `auth.remediation.password.title`; the fallback message is shared and unchanged.** Right, and the A3 reasoning is sound: "Your password has expired" is false for an administrator-forced change.
- **`@object-ui/i18n`: one new key under `auth.remediation.password` in all ten packs.** Right on both counts I checked: `TranslationKeys = typeof en` is published from the entry, so the type gains one property (additive); the ten-pack parity and drift gates (`check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`) are inside `Repo Gates`, green on this head.
- **The hand-written literal.** Judged acceptable, not a second-source defect, on three facts: (a) the installed spec `^18.0.0-next.0` carries neither `AuthGateCodeSchema` nor the code, and objectstack `origin/main` at `e4ec6ec` has neither under `packages` (I re-ran the dev's `git grep`: zero hits); the enum exists only on the #23440 branch, so there is nothing to derive from in a package that builds against the published spec. (b) The two codes already accepted at base were already hand-written literals in this file, so the PR introduces no new class of second source, it consolidates the existing one into one named set. (c) The set carries a comment naming the spec symbol to derive from. What is missing is a gate, not a derivation: nothing will fail when the spec bump lands and the set is still hand-written. See ③.
- **Pins.** Both new tests exercise the published face (a real `Response` through `createAuthenticatedFetch`, the overlay rendered under `I18nProvider`), and the dev's two ablations each turned the right pin red. `Test (shard 1..12/12)`, `Test (dist pins)` and `Type Check` are green on this head.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/12365-password-reset-required-gate.md`: `minor` for `@object-ui/auth`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`. Right. Each is an additive widening of a published face (one more accepted backend code on the fetch wrapper's behaviour; one more routed code on the overlay; one more key on the pack type and data). Nothing is removed or renamed on any `exports` path, and no `package.json` contract field moves, so nothing is breaking; under objectui AGENTS.md §9 even a breaking change would be `minor`, never `major`, and `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Declaration` and `Changeset Fixed Group Check` are green on the head.
- `Clause-②:` yes, as the claim and the PR body say. The reason the claim gave (a published `detectAuthGate`) was the wrong mechanism; the published faces that widen are `createAuthenticatedFetch` / `AuthProvider.remediationRequired` and the `@object-ui/i18n` pack. The verdict on the clause does not change.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Deviation (file surface): the ten locale packs plus the changeset, outside the claim's two files.** Answered: the dispatch put A3 (the title copy) in scope and a new key must land in all ten packs or the parity gates fail; the changeset is mandatory for any `src/` change in the fixed group. No breach.
- **Deviation: `ExpiredPasswordForm` renamed `ChangePasswordForm`.** Answered: module-private, no export, no consumer.
- **`check:spec-floors` exit 1.** Answered: pre-existing on `main` (objectui#12334, "0 package(s) declare @objectstack/spec in a consumer-facing field"); `Repo Gates` is green on this head, so CI does not read it as this PR's.
- **Out-of-scope finding: `AUTH_GATE_CODES` should be derived from `AuthGateCodeSchema` once the spec exports it, "noted, not filed".** Escalated: the carrier is the `domain:devx` hop that bumps `@objectstack/spec` past objectstack#23440's landing, and today only a code comment names the debt, no gate and no card. Recommend the seat attach it to objectstack#23287's landing order (the same order that holds #23440 until `.objectui-sha` carries this fix) or file it on the objectui side, so the two-way dependency is written down somewhere a reader opens.
- **Order dependency.** objectstack#23440 is still open (head `5b59be6`); if its enum spelling changes before merge, this set drifts silently. The card names the literal, so this PR is right as filed; the previous flag covers the rest.
- Open questions: none in the report, none raised here.
